name: claude-agents
description: Agents and skills for planning, code review, testing and team communication

plugins.name: bug-walkthrough
plugins.description: Guides you through reproducing a bug or verifying a fix in the real app, one milestone at a time, checking each result in the database.

plugins.name: dev-planning
plugins.description: Turns a ticket into an investigated, test-baselined implementation plan, reviewed by subagents before any code is written.

plugins.name: integration-tester
plugins.description: Writes and runs unit or integration tests that follow the project's own conventions, and confirms they actually ran.

plugins.name: playwright-test-plan
plugins.description: Turns a ticket's test plan into local Playwright tests that run in a visible browser, with screenshots and a write-up. Experimental.

plugins.name: pr-codereviewer
plugins.description: Reviews a branch against its target and returns approve or block, with paste-ready comments that read like a colleague wrote them.

plugins.name: team-message-drafting
plugins.description: Drafts short Slack or Teams messages that only ask what research can't answer, and checks them for AI tells.
